pages.text: $(thing)Rhizobia (Nodule Bacteria)$() ($(o)Rhizobium, Bradyrhizobium and Sinorhizobium spp.$()), symbiont.$(br2)$(li)$(thing)Hosts:$() fabaceae.$(li)$(thing)Spreads:$() soilborne, seedborne.

$(li)$(thing)Survives$() 5 years (soil).$(li)$(thing)Benefit:$() +80% to its host.$(li)$(thing)Control:$() Inoculate seed when a legume is new to the field; Lime acid soils above pH 6.$(br2)Fix atmospheric nitrogen for the legume; the residue then feeds the next crop.
